name: Mick Parkin
summary: An underrated, durable English heavyweight who plugs away with solid power at a steady pace, with decent wrestling behind it; 10-1, the only loss a decision to Marcin Tybura, and back after 18 months out.

how_they_fight.Striking: Not pretty or dynamic, but a surprisingly deft striker for his size (Sherdog).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Decent wrestling to fall back on.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Sensible; needs to commit to pressure here.

concerns: Hittable against a long, explosive striker
keys_to_beat: Use length and counters as he walks in

sources.author: E. Spencer Kyte
